caption: The drawing depicts a wooden rocking chair centered on a plain, light beige background. The chair consists of several vertical spindles forming the backrest, all colored a natural brown wood tone with visible grain detailing. The seat is wide, rounded, and slightly concave, also rendered in brown with some dark cracks indicating its age or wear. The chair's legs are turned wood, with two curved rockers attached at the bottom, allowing the chair to rock back and forth. Overall, the colors used are variations of brown for the chair, contrasting against the solid, neutral background. The composition focuses solely on the rocking chair, with no other objects or details present.
title: Chair
